name: postgres-mcp
description: Adds Google's MCP Toolbox for Databases with its prebuilt PostgreSQL tools for schema inspection, SQL queries, and health and performance views. Sessions start with default_transaction_read_only on, so writes fail by default; this is a session default, not a permission boundary, so connect with a read-only database role. From 1.15.0 it replaces the archived reference server: set POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DATABASE, POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_PASSWORD instead of a connection URL; the server does not start with an empty password. Toolbox ships no Linux arm64 build.
